item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
What's new

  • ur.transcribe now updates itself. It checks for new versions once a day, and you can use Check for Updates… in the menu or in Settings. When an update arrives, the menu shows it instead of interrupting you, and it never restarts in the middle of a call.
  • Updates are signed with the project's key, and the app refuses any update that isn't.

This is the last version you need to download by hand. From here on, updates install from inside the app.

Install

  1. Download ur.transcribe-0.1.2-macos-arm64.dmg below.
  2. Open it and drag ur.transcribe into Applications, replacing the old version.
  3. Open it from Applications.

Signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Requires macOS 26 or later on Apple Silicon.
